record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Develop new constructions and ideas for minimal free resolutions of monomial ideals and toric ideals.

artifact.category_tag: Minimal free resolutions of monomial and toric ideals
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and let $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ denote the polynomial ring in $n$ variables, graded by $\deg(x_i) = 1$ (or, more generally, by a positive $\mathbb{Z}^n$-grading). Recall that a monomial ideal $I \subset S$ is an ideal generated by monomials $x^{a} = x_1^{a_1} \cdots x_n^{a_n}$, and a toric ideal is the kernel $I_A = \ker(\pi_A)$ of a $k$-algebra homomorphism $\pi_A : k[y_1, \dots, y_m] \to k[t_1^{\pm 1}, \dots, t_d^{\pm 1}]$ sending $y_j \mapsto t^{a_j}$ for a finite set $A = \{a_1, \dots, a_m\} \subset \mathbb{Z}^d$. For a finitely generated graded $S$-module $M$, a minimal graded free resolution is an exact complex
$$ \cdots \to F_2 \to F_1 \to F_0 \to M \to 0, \qquad F_i = \bigoplus_{j} S(-j)^{\beta_{i,j}(M)}, $$
in which each differential has entries in the maximal homogeneous ideal; the numbers $\beta_{i,j}(M)$ are the graded Betti numbers of $M$.

Problem. Develop new explicit constructions and conceptual methods for producing minimal free resolutions of arbitrary monomial ideals $I \subset S$ and of arbitrary toric ideals $I_A$. In particular, find constructive recipes (for example combinatorial, topological, simplicial, cellular, discrete-Morse-theoretic, or algorithmic) that, given the generators of $I$ (respectively the matrix $A$), output the modules $F_i$ and the differentials of a minimal free resolution, and thereby determine the graded Betti numbers $\beta_{i,j}$ for all $i, j$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of constructing minimal free resolutions of arbitrary monomial and toric ideals is a longstanding, broadly framed research direction. While many partial constructions exist (Taylor, Lyubeznik, Eliahou–Kirby, cellular and simplicial resolutions of Bayer–Sturmfels, lattice and CW resolutions of Batzies–Welker via discrete Morse theory, and recent advances such as the Eagon resolution and work on monomial ideals with linear quotients), no general construction is known. The question remains open as a guiding research program.

status_evidence.title: Cellular resolutions of monomial modules
status_evidence.snippet: Bayer and Sturmfels introduce CW-complex-supported resolutions; general minimality is not achieved for all monomial ideals.
status_evidence.claim: General minimal cellular resolutions remain elusive.

status_evidence.title: Discrete Morse theory and resolutions (Batzies–Welker)
status_evidence.snippet: Algebraic discrete Morse theory yields smaller resolutions but not minimal ones in general.
status_evidence.claim: Minimality is not guaranteed by current general methods.

status_evidence.title: Survey: Resolutions of monomial ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys note that constructing minimal free resolutions of arbitrary monomial ideals is still open.
status_evidence.claim: Problem remains an open research area.
